verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships a built-in AI assistant: Semgrep Assistant post-processes findings to reduce noise, and the platform pitches AI reasoning for detection, triage, and remediation. The evidence only shows automated triage and detection, not a user explicitly handing tasks to the assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of user-initiated task delegation to the assistant, details of the assistant's scope and interaction model (e.g., chat or requested fixes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Contextual post-processing of findings with Semgrep Assistant (AI) to further reduce noise by ~20%
Combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage, and remediation
With AI-Powered Detection, you can automatically identify complex business logic flaws, such as IDORs and broken authorization.
